The dialogue presents a clinical encounter focused on persistent fatigue. The patient reports fatigue of unspecified duration (not quantified in weeks/months), poor sleep, and unintentional weight loss over the past month — all red-flag symptoms warranting further investigation. No objective lab values are provided except for a normal CBC (WBC, hemoglobin, platelets), which rules out common hematologic causes (e.g., anemia, infection, malignancy) but does not exclude endocrine, metabolic, inflammatory, or psychiatric etiologies. - Resting heart rate or report of palpitations/tremor (supportive but not required for diagnosis)  
- Thyroid exam findings (goiter, bruit) — not reported  
- Appetite change (hyperthyroidism often features increased appetite despite weight loss) — not specified  

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Hyperthyroidism
